author: madhva
summary: Madhva's work determining the 'purport' of the Gita, written in addition to his shorter Gita Bhashya, reading it as teaching devotion to Vishnu within Dvaita.
whyRead: It shows how the Gita reads when difference between God and souls is taken as fundamental. Madhva engages earlier interpretations and supports his reading with a wide range of scriptural sources.
questions: What is the Gita's central purport?
How does Dvaita read the Gita's teaching on the Self?

keyTeachings.title: Supremacy of Vishnu
keyTeachings.text: Krishna, as Vishnu, is the independent supreme being on whom all else depends.

keyTeachings.title: Devotion grounded in knowledge
keyTeachings.text: Devotion, informed by knowledge of God's greatness, is the means to liberation, together with God's grace.

keyTeachings.title: Action as worship
keyTeachings.text: Duties are to be performed without desire for results, as worship of God.
